svg.title: The same face at three resolutions
svg.desc: The same drawing of a face shown three times: at 48 by 48 it is clear, at 12 by 12 the eyes are one square each, at 4 by 4 the face has gone completely. Circles mark what is lost at each step.
svg.text: The same face at three resolutions
Every shrink throws numbers away for good. You cannot get them back.
